text_block_list.text:
It's been quite the ride with Gold Ship in 
her quest for Eden so far, but—

We somehow managed to get ready for her 
debut…

If there's anything to be concerned about, 
it's Gold Ship's mood. However—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's it! Awesome, go for it!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Now when's she gonna shake…! Aaah, I can't look away from this!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What, you say? A chihuahua through a 
chikuwa.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
There are things to be learned by peering 
through the narrow field of view of the 
chikuwa's hole.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
That chihuahua must have thought long and 
hard about the timing to give its paw.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The same way horsegirls think about when 
to start spurting, how to make their 
moves.

I'm not sure I follow but it seems Gold 
Ship is thinking about the race in her own 
way… I believe?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Yooo what the, she went with down instead! You're supposed to shake!

Either way for now it seems all I can do 
is pray she takes the race seriously…!
